headline: MIN @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 4.53 at TEX 4.97, with a projected total of 9.50. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: MIN moved +1.19 runs while TEX moved +0.80, changing the projected margin by +0.39 runs. NRFI probability dropped -11.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kumar Rocker has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Byron Buxton, Josh Jung, Josh Bell, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
